lines.text: Three in the morning. Asa had the radio, and one question for Millbrook. Oakhaven. Day sixteen. Seth woke up to the radio hissing. Asa was at the table with the handset. Millbrook, this is Oakhaven. Quick question. The woman from Day four came back on. She asked if someone was hurt. If it was the horde. Asa asked if they had a museum. A long pause. Then she said they were in the museum. It's the only building in Millbrook with a generator. Her name is Dottie. On the second floor, next to a longship, there's a Danish greataxe. A thousand years old. Still in its case. Asa kept the generator running for two hours to keep her talking. That cost us two liters of fuel. The radio has a padlock on it now. And tape across the handset. No axe questions. Cold storage won. Sam, Kathryn and Marco went in, and all three came back. With ninety-one rations of food. We passed a hundred followers. So we walled off the whole block. The fence is stronger now, for good. To everyone who just followed, welcome. Two more at the gate today. Caleb, a sharpshooter. And Officer John, a guard. He used to work riot control. Forty-three of us. Food for two days. Water for one. The horde reaches the fence in five days. Asa has already asked if a fire station has axes. Where do we send the squad tomorrow? The air freight terminal, which nobody has ever searched. The greenhouse. Or Fire Station Three, with water still in the tanks. Comment your name and your job, to move in.
